evidence_reading_notes.note: Directly addresses the notation and beyond-AT(N) groups. Keep the source's might be useful, conceptualizing, may become available in the future and conditional examples; do not convert this into an already validated fixed X test or completed clinical adoption.
Separately describes adding biomarkers within the existing A/T/(N) groups and adding new groups beyond them. The current target concerns the latter.

The 2018 passage itself mentions V, synuclein and inflammation examples. Do not claim that these concepts were absent from 2018; also do not treat the examples as proof of every detail in the citing paper's newly presented tables.
